rca_of_issue: Invoice status pill silent-fail RCA: React Native Web's Alert module implementation is limited/inconsistent across versions (in some builds it maps to window.confirm, in others it is a no-op). The code at app/invoice/[id].tsx:167-190 calls Alert.alert('Change status', ..., [{text:'Cancel'}, ...options.map(s => ({text: s.toUpperCase(), onPress: ...}))]). On the current Expo web bundle this silently returns without any UI. Mitigation: wrap the call in a Platform.OS==='web' branch that renders a custom Modal with the four status options, or use react-native-modal / a shared showActionSheet utility. This does NOT affect native builds delivered to Kishan Sir's phone.
